scope: Implement and exercise the first host-safe GSQ/RCO compression preflight gate against the local Qwen3.8-Flash-Next BF16 source checkpoint and the pinned GSQ/RCO clones. This checks metadata, filenames, pinned revisions, and a Transformers version capable of loading qwen4_exp. It does not open a safetensors payload, instantiate the model, prune experts, train, quantize, pack, or run inference.

non_claims: No safetensors payload was opened and no model object was instantiated.
No GPU, CUDA environment, RCO search, GSQ quantization, LoRA heal, checkpoint build, Strata pack, or inference run was executed.
Transformers 5.16.0 is the documented support family used as the minimum; the earliest exact supporting patch release was not bisected.

This check depends on a local source checkpoint and pinned clones; it is not a default install or quality gate.
